extracted.intended_audience: general public, news readers, donors, supporters, and journalists
extracted.subtask_description: Principles and organizational commitments that describe how ProPublica conducts and prioritizes investigative journalism, including mission, scope, funding model, ethics, and impact orientation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission — expose abuses of power and betrayals of the public trust
rubrics_metrics.description: To expose abuses of power and betrayals of the public trust by government, business, and other institutions, using the moral force of investigative journalism to spur reform through the sustained spotlighting of wrongdoing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ProPublica frames its core purpose as identifying and publicizing wrongdoing and betrayals of public trust with the explicit goal of spurring reform; the mission statement is the primary organizing principle for story selection and work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the moral force of investigative journalism to spur reform
rubrics_metrics.description: Using the moral force of investigative journalism to spur reform through the sustained spotlighting of wrongdoing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reporting is expected not only to uncover wrongdoing but to catalyze real-world change; the organization emphasizes sustained attention until accountability or reform occurs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence and nonprofit newsroom model
rubrics_metrics.description: ProPublica is an independent, nonprofit newsroom that produces investigative journalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Independence and nonprofit status are presented as foundational to editorial decisions and credibility; funding and governance structures are tied to maintaining independence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Depth and persistence in reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: We dig deep into important issues, shining a light on abuses of power, and we stick with those issues as long as it takes to hold power to account.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investigative work is characterized as deep-dive, resource-intensive, and persistent; stories may require long-term tracking and sustained effort rather than quick reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topical scope — focus areas for coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: With a team of more than 150 dedicated journalists, ProPublica covers a range of topics including government and politics, business, criminal justice, the environment, education, health care, immigration, and technology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These subject areas define the newsroom's beats and priorities for investigative projects; story selection is guided by relevance to these domains.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact-driven story selection
rubrics_metrics.description: We focus on stories with the potential to spur real-world impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Impact is a key criterion for selecting investigations; ProPublica cites outcomes such as passage of new laws, reversals of harmful policies and practices, and accountability for leaders as measures of reporting success.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding model — donations power investigative work
rubrics_metrics.description: Investigative journalism requires a great deal of time and resources. As a nonprofit, ProPublica’s work is powered primarily through donations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page frames fundraising and donor support as necessary to sustain resource-intensive investigations; financial choices are explained in service of enabling deep reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparent financial reporting to donors
rubrics_metrics.description: We practice transparent financial reporting so donors know how their dollars are spent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Financial transparency is an explicit organizational standard intended to build trust with supporters and justify the nonprofit funding model; the claim ties stewardship to credibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal ethics and AI principles (referenced)
rubrics_metrics.description: Links to "Code of Ethics" and "AI Principles" are listed in the site navigation, indicating formal ethical and AI-related standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although the page does not reproduce those policies, it signals that ProPublica maintains formal ethical guidelines and AI principles which govern reporting practices and technology use.
